embeds.title: 🔴 Hole in GitHub's browser-based VSCode editor could lead to stolen token
embeds.description:
Researcher Ammar Askar disclosed a vulnerability in GitHub's browser-based VSCode editor (github.dev) that could allow threat actors to steal developer OAuth tokens with full repository access. The vulnerability involves malicious Jupyter notebook extensions that can extract GitHub API tokens. Microsoft applied a stopgap fix after receiving one hour notice from Askar before public disclosure. The researcher claims the vulnerability is 'about as serious as it gets' and could allow attackers to modify code repositories if they convince maintainers to click malicious links.
**Sources:** CSO Online • 🔴 1 corroborating
**CVEs:** none • **Access:** Malicious link to github.dev containing Jupyter notebook with webview script payload
**Incident date:** unknown • **Confidence:** claim
[Read source](https://www.csoonline.com/article/4180997/hole-in-githubs-browser-based-vscode-editor-could-lead-to-stolen-token-2.html)
